collection.title: Lexus LS Series LS 400 1994 to 2000 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Lexus LS 400 Series 1990 to 2000 model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade.
